what: Plan makes --manual and -m unknown instead of deprecated inert
scenario_or_breakage: Existing aliases or scripts that use the current safer manual mode abort at Step 0 even though Gate B is now always explicit
suggested_fix: Keep --manual and -m accepted-but-inert in parse-design-argv.sh, stop emitting MANUAL_REQUESTED, and do not persist manual_gate_b

what: Plan extends result env with DRIFT_* and BASELINE_* but does not require default initialization
scenario_or_breakage: With set -u, --with-plan-size failures before check-plan-size parses can abort while _postplan_build_kvs writes the new keys
suggested_fix: Initialize all DRIFT_* and BASELINE_* variables beside existing PLAN_SIZE defaults before any flush path

what: Write-once drift-baseline.env guard described as ! -f can follow a dangling symlink
scenario_or_breakage: A preexisting drift-baseline.env symlink to a non-existent target passes ! -f and the snapshot path can write outside DESIGN_TMPDIR
suggested_fix: Skip when the baseline path exists or is a symlink; otherwise write through a temp file plus rename or the existing result-env helper pattern
